fact: The Lead drafts one executable plan from the taskbook and the Fact Check findings.
The two members independently review the same candidate. The plugin collects both results before routing to Revise or Signoff.
A member finding identifies an affected Goal, Delivery item or step, a concrete counterexample, its evidence, and a correction. An approval identifies the reviewed version.
The Lead addresses each finding individually in a revision or rebuttal. Both members review the resulting candidate before signoff.
